basis: Isolated premature fusion of a cranial suture; neurologic injury is not intrinsic to this nonsyndromic form.
Historical tyrosine metabolism disorder; supplied information does not establish common damage to additional organs.

Developmental dentin disease affecting primary teeth and dental pulp; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Mature B-cell lymphoma; splenic and marrow involvement share the haematologic axis. Other supplied organ complications are occasional.

Congenitally shortened ligament fixes the scapula to the first rib; this is a shoulder-girdle structural disorder.
Basaloid follicular hamartomas, patterned skin pigmentation and acral skeletal abnormalities define the syndrome.
Lysosomal lipid storage disease with CNS demyelination. Muscle atrophy is neurogenic; visual loss is occasional, 5-29%.
Activated B-cell subtype of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; no additional organ site is specified.
Hypertrophy of the nasopharyngeal adenoid affects the upper airway. Associated otitis media is a separate disease.
Neuroendocrine neoplasm arising in rectal mucosa; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Isolated absence or failure of development of the uterine body affects a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Susceptibility specifically concerns glioma of the nervous system; it does not establish an existing tumor or additional organ damage.
Adenocarcinoma originating in the lung; no common direct involvement of another organ is established.
Complement-associated immune-mediated loss of subcutaneous fat defines acquired lipodystrophy. Glomerulonephritis occurs in 26% and is separately diagnosed.
An inborn disorder of glycosylation; supplied information establishes the metabolic mechanism but not frequencies of additional organ damage.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay define it; finger joint contractures affect 5/9 patients (~56%). Isolated cardiac and ocular reports do not establish common involvement.
Inherited corneal degeneration defines this umbrella; systemic manifestations of particular subtypes do not characterize most patients.
Telomere-related pulmonary fibrosis and bone marrow failure are the defining organ manifestations; additional involvement varies across subtypes.
The definition specifies intestinal Ascaridia infection, usually in fowl; this should not be conflated with human Ascaris infection.
Site-unspecified carcinoma histology; no organ axis can be assigned reliably. Squamous differentiation does not establish skin origin; listed subtypes include breast and penis.
Emery-Dreifuss disease is defined by muscular dystrophy, contractures and cardiac disease; ventricular septal hypertrophy is reported in this subtype.
